comment: Sample UQ-style catalogue. Assessment structures are plausible but illustrative — marked data_source=seed and verified so the app is demo-able. due_date belongs to the seeded profile version (first 2026 offering).

courses.title: Introduction to Software Engineering
courses.description: Introduction to programming and software engineering using Python: problem decomposition, abstraction, testing, classes and object-oriented design, and development of small applications.

assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.hurdle_description: Must score at least 40% on the final exam to pass the course.

courses.title: Calculus & Linear Algebra I
courses.description: Differential and integral calculus of one variable, sequences and series, vectors, matrices and linear equations. Foundation mathematics for science, engineering and computing.

assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.hurdle_description: Must score at least 45% on the final exam.

courses.title: Advanced Calculus & Linear Algebra I
courses.description: Rigorous treatment of calculus and linear algebra for high-achieving students: proofs, epsilon-delta limits, vector spaces and linear transformations.

courses.title: Discrete Mathematics
courses.description: Logic, set theory, relations and functions, induction, counting and combinatorics, graph theory and elementary number theory underpinning computer science.

courses.title: Calculus & Linear Algebra II
courses.description: Multivariate calculus, ordinary differential equations, Laplace transforms and further linear algebra, continuing MATH1051.

courses.title: Introduction to Information Systems
courses.description: Information systems in organisations: data modelling, relational databases, SQL fundamentals, business processes and the role of information technology in decision making.

courses.title: Introduction to Web Design
courses.description: Designing and building usable web sites: HTML, CSS, visual design principles, accessibility, information architecture and user-centred design methods.

courses.title: Analysis of Scientific Data
courses.description: Statistical thinking for scientists: study design, probability, estimation, hypothesis testing, regression and analysis of variance with real data sets.

courses.title: Programming in the Large
courses.description: Java programming in larger systems: static typing, class hierarchies, interfaces, generics, exceptions, unit testing and reasoning about program correctness.

courses.title: Introduction to Computer Systems
courses.description: How computers work from gates to programs: digital logic, machine-level representation, assembly programming, memory and embedded microcontroller projects.

courses.title: Computer Systems Principles & Programming
courses.description: Systems programming in C on UNIX: processes, file systems, networking with sockets, concurrency and the practical construction of robust command-line tools.

assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.hurdle_description: Must score at least 40% on the final exam.

courses.title: Relational Database Systems
courses.description: Relational database design and implementation: entity-relationship modelling, normalisation, SQL, transactions, indexing and query optimisation.

assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.hurdle_description: Must score at least 40% on the final exam.

courses.title: Algorithms & Data Structures
courses.description: Design and analysis of algorithms and data structures: complexity analysis, sorting, trees, hashing, graphs, dynamic programming and greedy algorithms.

assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.hurdle_description: Must score at least 40% on the final exam.

courses.title: Computer Networks I
courses.description: Computer networking: protocol layering, TCP/IP, routing, transport protocols, application protocols, network programming and network security fundamentals.

courses.title: Functional & Logic Programming
courses.description: Declarative programming paradigms: functional programming with Haskell, higher-order functions, type systems, lazy evaluation, and logic programming with Prolog.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Artificial intelligence techniques: search, constraint satisfaction, probabilistic reasoning, Markov decision processes, reinforcement learning and intelligent agent design.

assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.hurdle_description: Must score at least 50% on the final exam to achieve a grade of 4 or higher.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.description: Machine learning theory and practice: supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks and deep learning, model evaluation, regularisation and practical data-driven projects.

courses.title: Design Computing Studio 2 — Testable Design
courses.description: Studio-based team development of interactive software: agile practices, version control, user experience design, game and simulation development in Java.

courses.title: Software Engineering Studio: Design & Develop
courses.description: Team-based software engineering project: requirements elicitation, architecture and design, implementation with continuous integration, code review and stakeholder demonstrations.

courses.title: Advanced Database Systems
courses.description: Advanced data management: distributed databases, data warehousing, data integration, NoSQL systems, and query processing at scale.

courses.title: Advanced Algorithms & Data Structures
courses.description: Advanced algorithm design and analysis: amortised analysis, network flow, computational complexity, NP-completeness, approximation and randomised algorithms.
